arm.estimator: unchanged; observed and expected read from the saved null matrices c1_4_matrices.npz, only the weights differ
arm.name: lineage-balanced
arm.rule: each chromosomal occurrence is weighted by 1/k, where k is the number of occurrences sharing its (host, sequence type). A heavily sequenced clone then contributes the same total weight as a singleton lineage.
arm.untypeable: a genome whose scheme returns ST '-' is its own singleton lineage, not pooled, because pooling them would create one artificial mega-lineage out of the most divergent genomes

decision_rule.effect_is_lineage_artefact_if: A. baumannii lineage-balanced enrichment falls below 8.46, or the A. baumannii / Klebsiella ratio below 1.5
decision_rule.reported_regardless: the arm and the two NOT EVALUABLE groups, whatever it shows
decision_rule.thresholds_reused_from: NM-C1-006 and NM-C1-007, deliberately, rather than chosen now

raised_by: the paper argues BioProject balancing is not lineage adjustment, then does not offer a lineage-balanced weighting for its own primary enrichment
scope_limit: sequence types exist only for the 4,240 genomes of the primary contrast. P. aeruginosa and Enterobacter were never typed and are reported NOT EVALUABLE for this weighting.
title: Lineage-balanced weighting of the genome-wide background null
